verification.notes: VERIFICATION REQUIRES INTERACTIVE SESSION. Copilot docs: sessionStart fires for a new interactive Copilot CLI session, not on resume and not in non-interactive -p mode; the cloud agent fires it once per job.

limitations: Documented not to fire on resume or with -p, so resume gets no injection from this adapter (only N3 instructions could cover it).
Copilot ignores plain-text stdout for this event; the output must be JSON with a top-level additionalContext, which is why this adapter is Python-based.
The powershell key also calls bash (Git for Windows must be on PATH); a native PowerShell path is not provided.
For the cloud agent the hook file must be on the default branch.
The hook must live at .github/hooks/, not .copilot/ (same discovery gap already documented for the instructions file).
The CLI binary is bundled in the VS Code extension here; whether the account has an active Copilot license was not checked.
